Remark
[Quotient metric for an isometric action]

Source: petersen:page-0052 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-submersion

1. ch1:1.6.2Suppose a group $G$ acts isometrically on $(M,g)$, the orbit space $M/G$ is a manifold, and the quotient map is a submersion. Then $M/G$ has a unique Riemannian metric making the quotient map a Riemannian submersion.
